name: georgia-payroll
description: Payroll for employers in the country of Georgia (Sakartvelo, GE, currency GEL; not the US state) for tax year 2026. Covers who must withhold income tax from salary (Tax Code art. 154), the flat 20% rate, the employee's 2% funded pension contribution and why it comes off the income tax base, the employer's 2% contribution on top of pay, the state co-contribution (2% on the first GEL 24,000 a year, 1% up to GEL 60,000, nothing above), who must join the scheme and the age-40 opt-out, benefits in kind and the company car charge, salary paid by small businesses, non-resident employers, gross-to-net, the monthly return and payments by the 15th, and the fines (GEL 300 for a missed pension contribution, GEL 200 per unregistered employee, 0.05% a day interest). Trigger on: Georgia payroll, gross to net Georgia, salary tax Georgia, khelpasi, pension contribution Georgia employer, rs.ge monthly declaration. Out of scope: the annual return and other income (georgia-income-tax), self-employed pensi
